notes: A constant zero flow, v_zero, for closing a vessel port of a module that has more ports of a type than the model connects: listed in the module's inp_instances (or out_instances) in the place of the port to close, it takes that port (libcuflynx connects a module's single ports of one type in the order its neighbours are listed). Its vessel_port pairs v_zero with u, the pressure the closed module gives the port, which zero_flow takes and does not use. A monolithic heart with one vena cava lists it first among its vessel inputs, closing v_ivc.
